title: IRA-stimulated U.S. solar manufacturing capex to reach $12.2 billion by end 2026
summary: A new report by Terawatt PV Research provides the first detailed bottom-up analysis of U.S. PV manufacturing sites, including capital expenditure, productivity and technology. The findings reveal that PV manufacturing capex since the introduction of the Inflation Reduction Act accounts for more than half of all investments in U.S. PV manufacturing this century. The post IRA-stimulated U.S. solar manufacturing capex to reach $12.2 billion by end 2026 appeared first on pv magazine Global .

direction_reasons: CAPEX cuts both ways — growth against capital, cost or execution risk
watch_next: confirmation from an official or company source
